circuito-chico.name: Bariloche Circuito Chico
circuito-chico.description: Circuito Chico is the ideal way to start exploring Bariloche. A half day along Lake Nahuel Huapi, with stops at Cerro Campanario, Punto Panorámico and the Llao Llao Hotel. The city's most popular excursion.
highlights: Half day · approx. 4 hours
Departure 2:00 p.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Van or minibus transport
Bilingual guide and photo stops

cerro-catedral.name: Cerro Catedral Bariloche
cerro-catedral.description: South America's main winter sports center, 25 km from Bariloche. In winter it's the region's major ski hub; in summer, hiking and views of the cordillera and Lake Nahuel Huapi. Transfer from your accommodation.
highlights: Duration varies by season and activity
Departure 9:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Transport included
Optional guide — ask when booking

cerro-tronador-ventisquero.name: Cerro Tronador and Ventisquero Negro
cerro-tronador-ventisquero.description: Lakes Gutiérrez and Mascardi, Pampa Linda and imposing Ventisquero Negro on Cerro Tronador (3,554 m). A unique Patagonian landscape: the region's highest active volcano.
highlights: Full day · approx. 10 hours
Departure 8:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Specialized transport and mountain guide
National Park entrance included

siete-lagos-san-martin.name: San Martín de los Andes via the 7 Lakes
siete-lagos-san-martin.description: Full-day excursion on the legendary seven-lakes route: Villa La Angostura, viewpoints and arrival in San Martín de los Andes. One of Patagonia's most beautiful roads. Operates Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
highlights: Full day · approx. 10 hours
Departure 8:00 a.m. · Mon, Wed and Fri
Van transport and bilingual guide
Free time in San Martín de los Andes

bolson-lago-puelo.name: El Bolsón and Lake Puelo
bolson-lago-puelo.description: El Bolsón and Lake Puelo: regional craft fair, pebble beaches and the charm of the Río Azul valley. The capital of Patagonian crafts and ecology. Departs Thursdays and Saturdays.
highlights: Full day · approx. 10 hours
Departure 8:00 a.m. · Thursdays and Saturdays
Van transport and guide
National Park entrance included

isla-victoria-arrayanes.name: Victoria Island and Arrayán Forest
isla-victoria-arrayanes.description: About 30 minutes of navigation on Nahuel Huapi to Victoria Island: conifer nursery, viewpoints and volcanic beach. Then the Arrayán Forest on the Quetrihué peninsula — the only one publicly accessible in the world.
highlights: Full day · approx. 8 hours
Departure 10:00 a.m. from Puerto Pañuelo (km 25.5 Av. Bustillo)
Navigation, bilingual guide and entrance fees included
Victoria Island and Arrayán Forest

puerto-blest-cantaros.name: Puerto Blest and Los Cántaros Waterfall
puerto-blest-cantaros.description: Navigation along the Blest arm of Nahuel Huapi, the lake's lushest and rainiest branch. Visit to Los Cántaros waterfall and Puerto Blest. Optional: Lake Frías extension (booked separately).
highlights: Full day · approx. 9 hours
Departure 9:00 a.m. from Puerto Pañuelo
Round-trip navigation and guide
Hike to Los Cántaros waterfall

extension-lago-frias.name: Lake Frías Extension
extension-lago-frias.description: Add-on within the Puerto Blest excursion: internal transfer between ports, navigation on the green waters of Lake Frías — from volcanic sediment of the Frías glacier — and a short walk through Valdivian rainforest at Puerto Frías. Return to Puerto Blest.
highlights: Full day · approx. 8 hours
Booked as add-on to Puerto Blest
Internal port transfers and navigation
Bilingual guide and walk at Puerto Frías

traslado-puerto-panuelo.name: Puerto Pañuelo Transfer
traslado-puerto-panuelo.description: Round-trip transfer to Puerto Pañuelo, departure point for Bariloche's main lake excursions. Designed so you arrive on time for your boat without worrying about parking.
highlights: Approx. 30 minutes each way
Departure 9:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Door-to-dock transport
Coordinated with catamaran departures

cabalgata-medio-dia.name: Half-Day Horseback Ride
cabalgata-medio-dia.description: Half-day horseback ride through Andean Patagonian forest and scenery, with expert gaucho guides. Suitable for all levels. Morning shift (9:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m.) or afternoon (12:00 p.m.–6:00 p.m.).
highlights: Half day · approx. 6 hours
Morning 9:30 a.m. or afternoon 12:00 p.m. shift
Horse, equipment and gaucho guide
Breakfast or lunch included depending on shift

kayaks-lago-gutierrez.name: Kayaks on Lake Gutiérrez
kayaks-lago-gutierrez.description: Transfer to Lake Gutiérrez and two hours of kayaking with certified guides on crystal-clear waters surrounded by mountains. Instruction included; suitable for beginners.
highlights: Half day · approx. 3 hours
Departure 10:00 a.m. · Lake Gutiérrez campsite
Kayak, paddle, life jacket and guide
Instruction included for beginners

travesia-4x4-estepa.name: 4x4 Steppe Crossing with Lunch
travesia-4x4-estepa.description: Off-road tour in 4x4 vehicles across the Patagonian steppe: Cañón de la Luna, native wildlife and open landscapes very different from the lake circuit. Typical lunch included. Return approx. 6:00 p.m.
highlights: Full day · approx. 9 hours
Departure 9:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
4x4 vehicle and specialized guide
Typical lunch included

promo-aventura-fondue.name: Adventure Promo — Horseback + Snowshoes + Fondue
promo-aventura-fondue.description: Combined package: half-day horseback ride with barbecue, snowshoe walk at Roca Negra and cheese and chocolate fondue. Adventure and Patagonian dining in one booking.
highlights: Combined package · ask for itinerary when booking
Departure 9:00 a.m. · meeting point in Bariloche
Horseback ride with barbecue and snowshoes in the snow
Cheese and chocolate fondue · transfers included

raquetas-roca-negra.name: Snowshoes at Cerro López Roca Negra
raquetas-roca-negra.description: Transfer to the Cerro López base and snowshoe hike to Roca Negra refuge, with unique views of snowy Andean Patagonia. Pizza and hot drinks included on arrival.
highlights: Full day · approx. 8 hours
Departure 9:00 a.m. · meeting point in Bariloche
Snowshoes, poles and mountain guide
Pizza and hot drinks at Roca Negra

traslado-ski-catedral.name: Cerro Catedral Ski Transfer
traslado-ski-catedral.description: Round-trip transfer to Cerro Catedral, South America's main ski center, 25 km from Bariloche. Direct transfer from your accommodation. Multiple schedules available.
highlights: Approx. 30 minutes each way
Departure 8:30 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Round-trip transfer
Flexible schedules depending on season

villa-angostura-cerro-bayo.name: Villa La Angostura and Cerro Bayo
villa-angostura-cerro-bayo.description: Full-day excursion to Cerro Bayo ski center in Villa La Angostura, with views of Lake Correntoso. A more intimate, family-friendly atmosphere than Catedral.
highlights: Full day · approx. 10 hours
Departure 8:30 a.m. · pickup downtown accommodation
Transport, guide and Cerro Bayo entrance

laguna-congelada-neumeyer.name: Frozen Lagoon Walk — Neumeyer Refuge
laguna-congelada-neumeyer.description: Winter hike to the frozen lagoon at Neumeyer Refuge. Pure mountain scenery with snow and Patagonian nature. Soup and chocolate at the refuge.
highlights: Full day · approx. 8 hours
Departure 9:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Mountain guide and trekking poles
Soup and chocolate at the refuge

ski-nordico-cerro-otto.name: Nordic Ski on Cerro Otto
ski-nordico-cerro-otto.description: Transfer to the Nordic ski center on Cerro Otto. Guided cross-country skiing in a spectacular natural setting, with full instruction for beginners.
highlights: Half day · approx. 4 hours
Departure 9:30 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Nordic skis, poles and instructor
Hot drinks included

extremo-encantado.name: Extremo Encantado
extremo-encantado.description: Snow experience in the most magical corners of snowy Patagonia, with high-mountain specialist guides. Frozen waterfalls and ice formations.
highlights: Half day · approx. 5 hours
Departure 9:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Expert guide and snow equipment
Snacks included

cerro-perito-moreno-nieve.name: Cerro Perito Moreno — Winter Sports
cerro-perito-moreno-nieve.description: Excursion to Cerro Perito Moreno, a winter sports center of great scenic beauty. Round-trip transfer included. Suitable for the whole family.
highlights: Full day · approx. 10 hours
Departure 9:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Round-trip transfer
Mountain guide

noche-nordica-cerro-otto.name: Nordic Night on Cerro Otto
noche-nordica-cerro-otto.description: Evening experience: transfer to Cerro Otto, candlelit dinner at the revolving restaurant with panoramic night views of Bariloche. A unique romantic winter plan.
highlights: Evening · approx. 4 hours
Departure 6:30 p.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Dinner at refuge, drinks and night guide
Skis and poles included

ski-fun-day-perito-moreno.name: Ski Fun Day — Cerro Perito Moreno
ski-fun-day-perito-moreno.description: Full day of ski and snow activities at Cerro Perito Moreno. Ideal for the whole family. Round-trip transfer and specialized guide included.
highlights: Full day · approx. 10 hours
Departure 9:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Round-trip transfer and guide
Full day of snow activities

refugio-arelauquen.name: Arelauquen Refuge
refugio-arelauquen.description: Tour past Lakes Gutiérrez and Mascardi, crossing the Río Manso bridge to the private Arelauquen refuge in snowy forest. An intimate, exclusive experience.
highlights: Full day · approx. 10 hours
Departure 9:00 a.m. · pickup at your accommodation
Transfer and specialized guide
Hot drinks included

piedras-blancas-trineo.name: Piedras Blancas Winter Park — Sledding and Tubing
piedras-blancas-trineo.description: Winter complex on Cerro Otto slopes: 5 sledding and culipatín runs, scenic chairlift, snowtubing and zipline. Includes transfer, entrance and 6 chairlift rides. Ideal for the whole family.
highlights: Half day · approx. 4 hours
Departure 8:30 a.m. or 10:00 a.m. · meeting point in Bariloche
Transfer, entrance and 6 chairlift rides
Snowtubing and zipline included

snowcat-perito-moreno.name: Snowcat — Cerro Perito Moreno
snowcat-perito-moreno.description: Trip to Cerro Perito Moreno via Route 40. Chairlift ascent to 1,800 m and Snowcat ride — tracked vehicle — across the snowy plateau. Igloo visit and hot drink included.
highlights: Full day · approx. 12 hours
Departure 8:00 a.m. · meeting point in Bariloche
Transfer, chairlift and Snowcat
Igloo visit and hot drink

nieve-frontera-chile.name: Snow at the Limit — Argentina-Chile Border
nieve-frontera-chile.description: Excursion to the marker at Paso Cardenal Antonio Samoré on the Chilean border. Snowy forests, mini trek, skibunda, empanadas and hot drink. Bring valid ID.
highlights: Full day · approx. 8 hours
Departure 10:00 a.m. · meeting point in Bariloche
Transfer, mini trek and skibunda
Empanadas and hot drink · valid ID required

huechulafquen-lanin.name: Huechulafquen Lake, Paimún and Lanín Volcano
huechulafquen-lanin.description: Departure at 9:00 a.m. from San Martín de los Andes. You visit Junín de los Andes and the Laura Vicuña church, the mouth of the Chimehuín River, and Lake Huechulafquen with Lanín Volcano in the background throughout. Along the lakeshore you enter the Andean-Patagonian forest, lunch at a countryside restaurant run by the Mapuche community, and continue on Route 61 to Lake Paimún, the lakeside chapel, and a forest of thousand-year-old araucarias at the foot of Lanín. Return at 6:00 p.m.
highlights: Full day · departure 9:00 a.m. and return 6:00 p.m.
Junín de los Andes, Chimehuín River and Lake Huechulafquen
Lunch at a local Mapuche restaurant
Lake Paimún, chapel and thousand-year-old araucarias
Lanín National Park entrance fee not included

lacar-quila-quina.name: Lácar Lake Navigation to Quila Quina
lacar-quila-quina.description: Half-day excursion from San Martín along Lake Lácar, with views of Volcán Colorado and Cerro Sabana. You venture into lands of the Curruhuinca Mapuche Community and return to the lake with a different panorama toward Villa Quila Quina: a valley between water and mountains, with community settlements, summer homes, a café, a boat dock, and beaches to have lunch, share mate, or enjoy the backdrop of Cerro Abanico.
highlights: Half day from San Martín de los Andes
Curruhuinca Mapuche Community and Villa Quila Quina
Views of Volcán Colorado and Cerro Sabana
Dock, beaches and café facing Cerro Abanico
Lanín National Park entrance fee not included

laguna-de-los-tres.name: Laguna de los Tres
laguna-de-los-tres.description: The town's signature trek: ascent to the viewpoint facing Fitz Roy. The final stretch is steep; the reward is the view of the glacier and the spires.
highlights: Full day (8–10 h round trip from town)
Start early; bring food, water and warm layers
If winds are strong at the lagoon, rescheduling is advisable

condores-aguilas.name: Cóndores and Águilas Viewpoints
condores-aguilas.description: Short trails above town with views of Fitz Roy, Cerro Torre, and the Río de las Vueltas valley. Condors are often seen at sunset.
highlights: Under 2 h round trip; low difficulty
Perfect on arrival day for acclimatization
Very photogenic sunsets at Águilas

lago-del-desierto.name: Lago del Desierto and Huemul Glacier
lago-del-desierto.description: Excursion to the northern end of the valley, near the Chilean border. Turquoise lake, hanging glacier, and humid forest; requires more time than the town's classic trails.
highlights: Half or full day depending on whether you cross by boat
Landscape distinct from the classic Fitz Roy circuit
Check road conditions according to the season

los-alerces.name: Los Alerces National Park
los-alerces.description: UNESCO World Heritage site: emerald-green lakes and alerce trees over 2,600 years old in the temperate rainforest. Access via Villa Futalaufquen or Lago Verde.
highlights: Lake Menéndez and Glaciar Torrecillas viewpoint
Guided half-day or full-day hikes
Book well in advance in season (limited capacity)

lago-futalaufquen.name: Futalaufquen Lake Navigation
lago-futalaufquen.description: Tour along the lake's main arm within the park, with guides explaining glacial formation and forest flora.
highlights: Turquoise water between mountains
Suitable for those who prefer minimal physical effort
Subject to wind; spectacular on calm days

trevelin.name: Valle 16 de Octubre and Trevelin
trevelin.description: Route through the Welsh colony of Trevelin: windmills, homemade tea, waterfalls, and Patagonian steppe. Often combined with a day at Los Alerces.
highlights: Living Welsh culture (bakeries, museums)
Nant y Fall waterfall and mountain viewpoints
Done by car with stops; day tours also available

kayak.name: Kayaking in Villa La Angostura
kayak.description: Paddle a kayak through corners of Nahuel Huapi, Correntoso, Espejo, and other lakes on the Seven Lakes circuit. Guided departures with local experts who take you to places reachable only with proper equipment and local knowledge. An active way to disconnect and fully immerse yourself in the landscape.
highlights: Nahuel Huapi, Correntoso, Espejo lakes and more
Guided departures with local professionals
Proper equipment for each lake section
Ideal for those seeking adventure at their own pace

alquiler-bicicletas.name: Bicycle Rental
alquiler-bicicletas.description: Mountain bikes to explore the main circuits and natural landscapes of Villa La Angostura. Hourly or daily options with safety accessories. An active, sustainable way to discover Patagonia at your own pace.
highlights: Mountain bikes for local circuits and trails
Hourly or daily rental
Helmet and safety accessories included
Ideal to combine with beaches and viewpoints

bosque-arrayanes.name: Navigation to the Arrayán Forest
bosque-arrayanes.description: Boat ride across the lake to the Arrayán Forest, unique in the world. Trails among centuries-old arrayán trees, copper-toned landscape over the water, afternoon tea included, and return to the dock.
highlights: Lake navigation with a local guide
Arrayán forest on the Quetrihué peninsula
Trails and boardwalks among ancient trees
Afternoon tea included · return to the dock

peninsula-valdes.name: Península Valdés
peninsula-valdes.description: UNESCO reserve: elephant seals at Punta Delgada, Magellanic penguins at Punta Tombo (seasonal), and whales in the gulf from the cliff.
highlights: Full day by vehicle with interpretive stops
Orcas at Caleta Valdés (Feb–Apr, tide dependent)
Bring binoculars and warm clothing — windy year-round

ballenas-embarcacion.name: Whale Watching by Boat
ballenas-embarcacion.description: Departures from Puerto Pirámides (Península Valdés) to see southern right whales just meters from the boat. Main season: September to December.
highlights: Strict regulations to avoid disturbing the animals
Book weeks in advance during high season
Departures rescheduled if seas are rough

punta-loma.name: Punta Loma and Coastal Reserves
punta-loma.description: South American fur seals at Punta Loma reserve, 17 km from Madryn. An ideal complement if you don't have a full day for the peninsula.
highlights: Half day from downtown Madryn
Viewpoint over Golfo Nuevo
Pairs well with a city tour or free afternoon

perito-moreno.name: Perito Moreno Glacier
perito-moreno.description: Walkways facing an ice wall nearly 80 m high above Brazo Rico. Calving events and blue hues that shift with the daylight.
highlights: Year-round access to Los Glaciares National Park
Free time at viewpoints + optional south-face navigation
Arrive early in January and February

todo-glaciares.name: Todo Glaciares Navigation
todo-glaciares.description: Full day on the northern arm of Lake Argentino: Upsala, Spegazzini, and giant icebergs. One of the most comprehensive navigations in the south.
highlights: Boat to the front of rarely visited glaciers
Includes transfer from Calafate and deck time
Book in advance during the austral summer

laguna-nimez.name: Laguna Nimez Reserve
laguna-nimez.description: Interpretive trail beside Lake Argentino, minutes from downtown. Flamingos, black-necked swans, and migratory birds depending on the season.
highlights: 1–2 h easy walk; great on arrival or farewell day
Sunset over Lake Argentino
Separate entrance from the glacier park

bosque-sumergido.name: Navigation to the Submerged Forest
bosque-sumergido.description: A unique experience to explore an ancient forest submerged beneath the waters of Lake Traful, with natural scenery and crystal-clear water. Ideal for those seeking adventure, nature, and views found nowhere else in Patagonia.
highlights: Submerged forest visible from the boat or by snorkeling
Crystal-clear water on calm days
Local guides explain the valley's geology
Subject to weather and season

cabalgata.name: Horseback Riding in Traful
cabalgata.description: Ride mountain trails and Patagonian forests on horseback, with unique landscapes, pure air, and unforgettable views of Villa Traful and Lake Traful.
highlights: Guided departures on mountain trails
Patagonian forest and lake viewpoints
Suitable for different experience levels
Check schedules and availability by season

tierra-del-fuego.name: Tierra del Fuego National Park
tierra-del-fuego.description: Fuegian forest, peat bogs, and Beagle Channel coastline. Classics: Coastal Trail, Lapataia (end of Route 3), and the End of the World train (optional).
highlights: Half day or full day depending on trails chosen
Views of Chilean mountains from the coast
Strong winds common — waterproof layer essential

canal-beagle.name: Beagle Channel Navigation
canal-beagle.description: Tour along the channel separating Argentina and Chile: Les Éclaireurs Lighthouse, Bird Island, and sea lions on Sea Lion Island.
highlights: 4–6 h departures from Ushuaia port
Option to visit Estancia Harberton (depending on tour)
Cold on deck even in summer

laguna-esmeralda.name: Laguna Esmeralda Trek
laguna-esmeralda.description: Lenga forest and peat bogs to an emerald-colored glacial lagoon, with views over Valle de Tierra Mayor. One of the city's most popular treks.
highlights: About 4–5 h round trip; muddy final sections
Waterproof boots almost essential
In winter may require snowshoes or crampons
